lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam dhan keetaa poore gur parasaad ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak has made the Lord's Name his wealth, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੋਹੁ ਨ ਚਲੀ ਖਸਮ ਨਾਲਿ ਲਬਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhohu na chalee khasam naal lab mohi vigute ||
lines.translation: Deception does not work with our Lord and Master; through their greed and emotional attachment, people are ruined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਬ ਕਰਨਿ ਭਲੇਰਿਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: karatab karan bhaleriaa mad maaiaa sute ||
lines.translation: They do their evil deeds, and sleep in the intoxication of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਨਿ ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੁਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phir phir joon bhavaaeean jam maarag mute ||
lines.translation: Time and time again, they are consigned to reincarnation, and abandoned on the path of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਦੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਜੁਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: keetaa paain aapanaa dukh setee jute ||
lines.translation: They receive the consequences of their own actions, and are yoked to their pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਸਭ ਮੰਦੀ ਰੁਤੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naai visaariai sabh ma(n)dee rute ||12||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if one forgets the Name, all the seasons are evil. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਠੰਦਿਆ ਬਹੰਦਿਆ ਸਵੰਦਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: utha(n)diaa baha(n)diaa sava(n)diaa sukh soi ||
lines.translation: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, be at peace;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਲਾਹਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahiai man tan seetal hoi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are cooled and soothed. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੁਆਰਥੁ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: laalach atiaa nit phirai suaarath kare na koi ||
lines.translation: Filled with greed, he constantly wanders around; he does not do any good deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis gur bhetai naanakaa tis man vasiaa soi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord abides within the mind of one who meets with the Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਵਸਤੂ ਕਉੜੀਆ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਉ ਮਿਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe vasatoo kauReeaa sache naau mithaa ||
lines.translation: All material things are bitter; the True Name alone is sweet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਾਂ ਚਖਿ ਸਾਧੀ ਡਿਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saad aaiaa tin har janaa(n) chakh saadhee dithaa ||
lines.translation: Those humble servants of the Lord who taste it, come to savor its flavor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham jis likhiaa man tisai vuthaa ||
lines.translation: It comes to dwell within the mind of those who are so pre-destined by the Supreme Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਯਾ ਕੁਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik nira(n)jan rav rahiaa bhaau duyaa kuthaa ||
lines.translation: The One Immaculate Lord is pervading everywhere; He destroys the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਤੁਠਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: har naanak ma(n)gai joR kar prabh devai tuthaa ||13||
lines.translation: Nanak begs for the Lord's Name, with his palms pressed together; by His Pleasure, God has granted it. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਚੜੀ ਸਾ ਸਾਰੁ ਜੋ ਜਾਚੰਦੀ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaachaRee saa saar jo jaacha(n)dee hekaRo ||
lines.translation: The most excellent begging is begging for the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਲੑੀ ਬਿਆ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਣੀ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gaalhee biaa vikaar naanak dhanee vihooneeaa ||1||
lines.translation: Other talk is corrupt, O Nanak, except that of the Lord Master. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਹਿ ਜਿ ਵਿਧਾ ਮੰਨੁ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਵਿਰਲੋ ਥਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: neehi j vidhaa ma(n)n pachhaanoo viralo thio ||
lines.translation: One who recognizes the Lord is very rare; his mind is pierced through with the Love of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋੜਣਹਾਰਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਪਧਰੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: joRanahaaraa sa(n)t naanak paadhar padharo ||2||
lines.translation: Such a Saint is the Uniter, O Nanak - he straightens out the path. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee sevihu jeeaRe daataa bakhasi(n)d ||
lines.translation: Serve Him, O my soul, who is the Giver and the Forgiver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ਹੋਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kilavikh sabh binaas hon simarat govi(n)d ||
lines.translation: All sinful mistakes are erased, by meditating in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਦਸਿਆ ਜਪੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har maarag saadhoo dasiaa japeeai gurama(n)t ||
lines.translation: The Holy Saint has shown me the Way to the Lord; I chant the GurMantra.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਆਦ ਸਭਿ ਫਿਕਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa suaad sabh phikiaa har man bhaava(n)d ||
lines.translation: The taste of Maya is totally bland and insipid; the Lord alone is pleasing to my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: dhiaai naanak paramesarai jin ditee ji(n)d ||14||
lines.translation: Meditate, O Nanak, on the Transcendent Lord, who has blessed you with your soul and your life. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਤ ਲਗੀ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vat lagee sache naam kee jo beeje so khaai ||
lines.translation: The time has come to plant the seed of the Lord's Name; one who plants it, shall eat its fruit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tisahi paraapat naanakaa jis no likhiaa aai ||1||
lines.translation: He alone receives it, O Nanak, whose destiny is so pre-ordained. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਣਾ ਤ ਸਚੁ ਇਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)ganaa ta sach ik jis tus devai aap ||
lines.translation: If one begs, then he should beg for the Name of the True One, which is given only by His Pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jit khaadhai man tripateeai naanak saahib daat ||2||
lines.translation: Eating this gift from the Lord and Master, O Nanak, the mind is satisfied. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੇ ਖਟਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: laahaa jag mahi se khatahi jin har dhan raas ||
lines.translation: They alone earn profit in this world, who have the wealth of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਸਚੇ ਦੀ ਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: duteeaa bhaau na jaananee sache dee aas ||
lines.translation: They do not know the love of duality; they place their hopes in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵਿਆ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: nihachal ek sareviaa hor sabh vinaas ||
lines.translation: They serve the One Eternal Lord, and give up everything else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham jis visarai tis birathaa saas ||
lines.translation: One who forgets the Supreme Lord God - useless is his breath.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਜਨ ਰਖਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)th laai jan rakhiaa naanak bal jaas ||15||
lines.translation: God draws His humble servant close in His loving embrace and protects him - Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਮੀਹੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham phuramaaiaa meehu vuthaa sahaj subhaai ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God gave the Order, and the rain automatically began to fall.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਰਜੀ ਤਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)n dha(n)n bahut upajiaa prithamee rajee tipat aghaai ||
lines.translation: Grain and wealth were produced in abundance; the earth was totally satisfied and satiated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa gun ucharai dukh daalad gaiaa bilaai ||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and pain and poverty shall run away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab likhiaa paaiaa miliaa tisai rajaai ||
lines.translation: People obtain that which they are pre-ordained to receive, according to the Will of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paramesar jeevaaliaa naanak tisai dhiaai ||1||
lines.translation: The Transcendent Lord keeps you alive; O Nanak, meditate on Him. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:
